scope: Offline replay of previously accepted historical materials; no live production operation or new translation.

validation.skip_reason: D29 real source/translated book fixtures were not supplied.
validation.isolation: Python network audit guard, disabled real dotenv discovery, temporary databases and caches; historical replay also forbids database access and file writes.
validation.checkpoint_regression: A synthetic paragraph carrying occurrence uncertainty is reused on the second run with no additional model transport calls. All model responses are fixtures.

private_replay.new_context_signal: One previously manually identified parenthetical duplicate transliteration is now flagged for review, without changing its text.

limitations: Occurrence counts are evidence gaps, not proof of omission: pronouns and legitimate compression remain non-blocking review cases.
Unknown translations cannot be semantically aligned without additional evidence. Parenthetical variant detection is restricted to explicit dotted CJK names.
This record does not claim production deployment, a fresh online artifact check or a paid end-to-end translation. CI is checked after pushing the containing commit.
